title: On a phone, the console's Frequency mark goes back to the Feed

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-20 (project thread: Make the admin logo go to the feed on mobile): "In the admin sections on the mobile app, the logo needs to go back to the feed."

detail: Under 960px the console sidebar (and its wordmark, which already went to /feed) is hidden, so the phone top bar had no Frequency mark at all: the top-left tap was the Space's own avatar and name, which opens the console home. The phone top bar now opens with the Frequency roundel linking to /feed (named 'Frequency, back to the Feed'), the same as the member header, ahead of the Space identity, which still opens console home. One shell (AdminShell) draws both /admin and every /spaces/<slug>/manage console, so this covers all of them. Wide screens are unchanged.

verify.note: Fails while the phone console top bar has no /feed Frequency mark, the mark is hidden at phone width, or the mask sits on the link and clips its focus ring.
